topic: Large Language Models (LLMs) and the Transformer Architecture
target_audience: University students with a basic background in computer science

sections.title: Introduction: From Sequential Reading to Global Context
lecture_lines: RNNs process text word by word sequentially.
This approach limits understanding of global context.
Transformers read entire sequences simultaneously instead.
animations: Display title "Introduction: From Sequential Reading to Global Context" in #FFFFFF.
Fade in three text blocks representing words in #FFD700.
Show lines connecting words to a central "Context" box in #00FFFF.

sections.title: Prerequisite Concept: Embeddings and Vector Space
lecture_lines: Words are converted into multi-dimensional vectors.
Similar meanings cluster together in space.
Distances represent semantic relationships between concepts.
animations: Show a vector as an arrow in #FF4500 from origin.
Display multiple vectors clustered in a 2D space colored #32CD32.
Highlight a specific vector point with a blue #1E90FF circle.

sections.title: The Core Engine: Self-Attention Mechanism
lecture_lines: Self-attention acts as a relevance map.
Each word attends to all others simultaneously.
Vectors determine contextual dependencies between words.
Query, Key, and Value models interactions.
Attention highlights specific, relevant information pathways.
animations: Show three boxes labeled Q, K, V in #FFFFFF.
Animate a matrix multiplication flow between Q and K in #FF69B4.
Fade in the Attention Score as a heatmap in #FFA500.
Display the weight sum applied to V in #00CED1.
Show final output box forming in #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Scaling Up: From Transformer to LLM
lecture_lines: Stacking layers builds deep pattern recognition.
Training on massive datasets enhances reasoning.
Models synthesize complex information across domains.
animations: Display a single transformer block in #FFFFFF.
Duplicate the block multiple times in a vertical stack colored #8A2BE2.
Animate data flowing through the entire stack, colored #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Conclusion: The Generative Loop
lecture_lines: LLMs use next token prediction generative loops.
Probabilities determine the most likely continuation.
The model builds stories through iterative prediction.
